Frontal lessons, with approximately 40% dedicated to commented exercise solving.
All lessons are held on a tablet.

Additional notes on specific course topics.
Materials for exam preparation, including collections of past exam papers.
Weekly self-assessment exercises will be proposed on Moodle, with solutions provided later in class or directly on the platform.
Interactive quizzes to stimulate active learning.
A tutoring service (in person or via Zoom) will be activated weekly for 2 hours, dedicated to solving practice exercises.

assessment_methods.method: Written exam (exercises and open-ended theory questions)
Integrative test (theory or exercises, if applicable)
Exercises with calculations and written arguments
Oral exam (optional, may raise, confirm, or lower written score)

assessment_rules: The exam consists of a written test with exercises and open-ended theory questions. The test is passed if both the exercise part and the theory part are sufficient; otherwise, the entire exam must be repeated. In doubtful cases, an integrative test (theory and/or exercises) may be required. For the F partition, the final grade is assigned considering all exam components, with double weight given to the exercise part compared to the theory part. For the C partition, an oral exam may follow the written exam, and its grade can raise, confirm, or lower the written score.
